description: This Go source file is a command-line tool that processes an Android.bp-like input (in JSON format), parses it using the blueprint parser, flattens the modules into a specific structure, and outputs the result in either bash or JSON formats. It includes functions to parse, evaluate, and flatten blueprint modules, along with CLI handling.

classes.name: FlatModule
classes.description: Represents a flattened module with type, name, and property map

methods.name: expandScalarTypeExpression
methods.description: Expands a parser.Expression into a scalar Go value if possible

methods.name: populatePropertyMap
methods.description: Populates a property map from a parser.Map, supporting nested structures

methods.name: flattenModule
methods.description: Converts a parser.Module into a FlatModule with flattened properties

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads and parses an input file or stream, returns flattened modules

methods.name: printBash
methods.description: Outputs the flattened modules in bash declare format
